summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca itself in Apollodorus' catalogue — a distinct figure from the Trojan Pronous whom Sarpedon slew in the Iliad.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pronous among the twelve wooers of Penelope who came from Ithaca itself, listed with Antinous, Liodes, Eurynomus, Amphimachus, Amphialus, Promachus, Amphimedon, Aristratus, Helenus, Dulicheus, and Ctesippus.
